title: India is back at World's #5 Stock Market — $5.45 Trillion story #Shorts
description:
In May 2026, India was ranked #6 globally. This November, it climbed back to #5 with a $5.45 trillion market cap.

Taiwan's AI rally crashed. FIIs poured ₹66,302 crore in November alone. Nifty is up 14% from its October low.

India is now just $220 billion away from Hong Kong at #4.

Sources: Bloomberg, Business Today (Nov 12, 2026)
